_about: Curated year-by-year supplement written for GeoHistory from general knowledge (conservative: well-established dates only). Each entry names the English Wikipedia article it is about; tools/build_curated.py sets "verified" when the Wikidata item of that article carries the same year. Places are approximate (nearest town).

events.label: Hijra: Muhammad moves to Medina
events.desc: Muhammad and his followers leave Mecca for Yathrib (Medina); the Islamic calendar counts from this year.

events.label: Battle of Badr
events.desc: The Muslims of Medina defeat a larger Meccan force.

events.label: Battle of Uhud
events.desc: The Meccans defeat the Muslims outside Medina but do not follow up.

events.label: Battle of the Trench
events.desc: A Meccan-led confederation besieges Medina and withdraws.

events.label: Treaty of Hudaybiyyah
events.desc: Muhammad and the Quraysh of Mecca agree a truce.

events.label: Conquest of Mecca
events.desc: Muhammad takes Mecca almost without fighting.

events.label: Death of Muhammad; Abu Bakr becomes caliph
events.desc: Muhammad dies in Medina and Abu Bakr is chosen to lead the community, the first of the Rashidun caliphs.

events.label: Ridda Wars
events.desc: Abu Bakr's armies defeat Arabian tribes that broke away after Muhammad's death.

events.label: Battle of the Yarmuk
events.desc: The Arabs defeat the Byzantine army and go on to take Syria.

events.label: Battle of al-Qadisiyyah
events.desc: The Arabs defeat the Sasanian army in Iraq.

events.label: Arab conquest of Egypt completed
events.desc: Amr ibn al-As completes the conquest of Byzantine Egypt; Alexandria is handed over under a treaty.

events.label: Battle of Nahavand
events.desc: The Arabs break the last large Sasanian army.

events.label: Uthman becomes caliph
events.desc: Uthman succeeds the murdered Umar as third caliph.

events.label: First Fitna begins
events.desc: The murder of Uthman starts the first civil war of the caliphate; Ali becomes caliph.

events.label: Battle of Siffin
events.desc: Ali and Muawiya fight on the Euphrates and agree to arbitration.

events.label: Umayyad Caliphate founded
events.desc: After Ali's murder Muawiya becomes caliph and rules from Damascus.

events.label: Battle of Karbala
events.desc: Husayn ibn Ali, grandson of Muhammad, is killed by an Umayyad army.

events.label: Dome of the Rock completed
events.desc: Caliph Abd al-Malik completes the Dome of the Rock in Jerusalem (691 or 692).

events.label: Muslim conquest of the Iberian Peninsula begins
events.wiki: Muslim conquest of the Iberian Peninsula
events.desc: Tariq ibn Ziyad crosses from North Africa and defeats the Visigothic king Roderic.

events.label: Siege of Constantinople begins
events.desc: An Umayyad army and fleet besiege Constantinople and fail.

events.label: Battle of Tours
events.desc: Charles Martel's Franks defeat an Umayyad raiding army between Tours and Poitiers.

events.label: Battle of the Zab
events.desc: The Abbasids defeat the last Umayyad caliph, Marwan II.

events.label: Abbasid Caliphate founded
events.desc: The Abbasid family takes the caliphate; Baghdad is founded as its capital in 762.

events.label: Battle of Talas
events.desc: An Abbasid army defeats a Tang Chinese army in Central Asia.
